[[Keiran's Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] received from [[Gwen]] during the [[Hearts of the North]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])

== Notes ==
* This weapon is automatically [[customized]] to the character but does not have the Damage +20% bonus usually applied.
* It cannot be modified with component upgrades.
* This weapon appears to be an [[Ithas Bow]].
* Gwen will not give the bow if it is already in your inventory.
* The bow must be equipped in order to begin the the [[Hearts of the North]] mini-missions. However, once you have begun a mission you can use any bow:
** For example, you can take advantage of the speed of shortbows or the range of flatbows.
** Upgrades affecting maximum energy, health, or attributes will not be applied due to the effects of the [[Keiran Thackeray (disguise)|mission disguise]].
** Upgrades that affect [[armor rating]], damage, [[armor penetration]], or duration of [[condition]]s will be applied.
* Other items with this appearance:
**{{r}} [[Ithas Bow]]
**{{r}} [[Ithas Bow (promotional)|Ithas Bow]] ([[Promotional weapon|promotional]])

==Trivia==
* Players who have acquired 22 points through the [[Hall of Monuments]] can obtain the [[GW2:Ithas Longbow|Ithas Longbow]] in [[Guild Wars 2]], which is claimed to be "just like the famed longbow wielded by the hero Lieutenant Thackeray during the Krytan Civil War."
